svg.title: Verified FastAPI event sequences for synthetic Ollama streams
svg.desc: Eight deterministic cases show three successful streams ending in complete, three mid-stream failures ending in an SSE error event with HTTP 200, and two pre-stream failures returning HTTP 502 or 503.
